Name: representative_ligand_id
Description: Ligand ID selected as the representative for a ligand-pocket group

Name: representative_system_id
Description: System ID selected as the representative for a ligand pocket or protein interface

Name: ligand_is_3d_score_able
Description: Whether the canonical ligand SDF supports finite shape, color, and SuCOS self-scoring

Name: receptor_set_id
Description: Stable identifier for the representative set of receptor chains

Name: receptor_chain_asym_ids
Description: Asymmetric-chain IDs in the representative receptor-chain set

Name: pocket_residues
Description: Representative pocket residues encoded as asym ID, residue number, and zero-based resolved-chain index

Name: interactions
Description: Representative protein-ligand interactions encoded with their receptor residue mapping and interaction type
